title: HELIX Bridge: Workday HCM → Absence Management / Leave

source_objects.description: Extended leave: FMLA, personal, medical, sabbatical, military. Equivalent to PS_LEAVE_PLAN + PS_JOB.ACTION = 'LOA'.
Day-level absence: vacation, sick, personal, bereavement, jury duty. Equivalent to PS_GP_ABS_EVENT.
Plan definition: accrual rules, carryover, maximum balance, waiting period. Equivalent to PS_LEAVE_PLAN_TBL.
Current accrued/available/used balances per absence plan. Equivalent to PS_LEAVE_ACCRUAL.

attribute_mappings.source: Absence Request.Absence_Type or Leave of Absence.Leave_Type

attribute_mappings.transformation: Boolean. Whether this leave counts against FMLA entitlement (12 weeks/year for eligible employees).
Running total of FMLA hours used in the 12-month measurement period.

notes: Absence data is confidential. FMLA records are particularly sensitive — medical certification documents must be stored separately with restricted access. Higher ed specific: sabbatical leave (typically tenured faculty, every 7 years, at half or full pay), professional development leave, and academic break periods (winter/summer) which may or may not use leave accruals.
